# FocusSpace

> FocusSpace is a pomodoro timer for iPhone and iPad by Sefa Beker. It turns the Pomodoro Technique into a journey
> through space: every finished 25-minute focus fills a fuel cell, and five cells take you to the next of 15 stops from
> Earth to interstellar space, at real distances. Free download; FocusSpace Pro (US: $24.99 a year with a one-week free
> trial, $3.99 a month, $49.99 lifetime) adds a day plan, Apple Intelligence on device, all sounds, themes and lengths.
> No account, no ads, no tracking; data stays on the device. 12 languages. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6754571776

- [Home](https://sefabkr.github.io/focusspace-web/): features, price, questions
